headline: Banco Provincia Study Shows 36% of Private Workers Deplete Monthly Balances
summary: A Banco Provincia study of 320,000 payroll accounts revealed that 36% of private sector employees run out of savings account funds by the 10th of each month.
why: Payroll account metrics highlight real wage dynamics, household cash constraints, and consumer credit stability in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentine Banking
impacts.why: Early depletion of monthly payroll balances reflects constrained domestic consumption capacity.
